evidence.topic: Class-local group-code meanings make a generic denylist insufficient
evidence.observed: Autodesk documents groups 92/310 as common AcDbEntity proxy graphics, MLEADER group 92 as text color, OLE2FRAME group 310 as OLE binary payload, and TABLE group 92 as both common proxy length and later AcDbTable column count. Local canReplayTypedProxyGraphics currently admits MLEADER and OLE frame types. Local MLEADER parsing maps 92 directly to styleTextColor; OLE frame parsers capture 310 as class payload.
doesNotEstablish: runtime corruption or loss on a producer-authored MLEADER/OLE file
that all classes other than these examples have collisions
that a peer or native application accepts the emitted result
evidence.planUse: Add PAR-128/7AP.5: replace broad generic admission via incomplete exclusions with an explicit per-entity capability tied to parse/write subclass scope; retain LINE as sole positive until a generated type-specific round-trip closes.
